scorecard.analysis_type: Class-Separated Distribution Drift & Covariate Shift Scorecard (Remediation & Audit)

methodology.psi_bins: 10 quantile bins derived from reference training partition; exact [-inf, 0.5, inf] categorical bins for binary features
methodology.ks_test: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test (scipy.stats.ks_2samp) with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction across m=36 tests
methodology.discrete_binary_tests: Two-sample pooled z-tests for binary proportions
methodology.wasserstein_metric: First Wasserstein distance (unnormalized and scale-normalized by reference std)
methodology.domain_cluster_bootstrap: 2,000-iteration cluster bootstrap resampling registered domains with fixed seed 42

observational_diagnostics.legitimate_partition_shift: Empirical quantification reveals severe covariate shift across legitimate web URLs: 11 of 18 features exhibit severe PSI (>= 0.25), led by SpacialCharRatioInURL (PSI = 6.79), NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (PSI = 4.97), NoOfSubDomain (PSI = 2.28), NoOfEqualsInURL (PSI = 2.04), NoOfQMarkInURL (PSI = 1.99), URLLength (PSI = 1.34), and DomainLength (PSI = 1.24). Under scale-normalized Wasserstein distance, query features display extreme divergence: NoOfQMarkInURL (norm W1 = 12.07), NoOfEqualsInURL (norm W1 = 8.90), NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (norm W1 = 4.84). This empirical disparity aligns directly with the structural composition of the PhiUSIIL benign training data (where 100% lacked query parameters and mean special characters = 1.25) versus live authentic operational routes that routinely possess query strings (30.4%) and multi-level path hierarchies (mean special characters = 3.82). The data establishes significant distribution divergence; causal attribution to synthetic augmentation or specific features requires controlled counterfactual intervention.
observational_diagnostics.phishing_partition_shift: In contrast to the legitimate partition, phishing URLs exhibit substantially milder covariate drift: mean PSI is 0.1877 (vs 1.3280 for legitimate). Only 5 features show severe PSI in phishing, primarily IsHTTPS (PSI = 0.33, reflecting external phishing having 79.2% TLS adoption vs 52.1% in historical training), NoOfSubDomain (PSI = 0.79), TLDLength (PSI = 0.46), and NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL (PSI = 0.57). Query parameters in phishing (NoOfEqualsInURL PSI = 0.06, NoOfQMarkInURL PSI = 0.02) show negligible drift because phishing URLs in both environments consistently utilized query strings.
observational_diagnostics.asymmetric_drift_implication: The observed covariate shift is highly asymmetric: legitimate URL structures diverged dramatically from the training baseline (mean D_KS = 0.306, mean PSI = 1.328), while phishing URL structures remained comparatively stable (mean D_KS = 0.134, mean PSI = 0.188). This asymmetric shift is consistent with the ensemble's high false-positive rate on benign URLs.
observational_diagnostics.linkage_to_historical_fpr: In Milestone 5.1, production control E0 exhibited a 94.15% false-positive rate (612/650) and candidate E4 exhibited a 92.62% false-positive rate (602/650) on the qualified external benchmark at threshold T=0.75. Stage 1 tree-path analysis proved that decision splits in both ensembles rely heavily on special characters, length, and query markers. Because benign training instances entirely lacked query markers and possessed low special-character ratios, authentic benign operational URLs bearing query parameters and complex routes map into feature regions assigned high phishing probabilities by the learned decision trees.

audit_finding_c_domain_clustering.methodology: Public-suffix-aware domain clustering with 2,000-iteration cluster bootstrap

methodology.multiple_testing_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) False Discovery Rate (FDR) control at alpha = 0.05
methodology.continuous_ks_limitation: The two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test assumes continuous underlying distributions without ties. For binary flags (IsHTTPS, HasObfuscation, IsDomainIP) and small-integer count features, ties heavily occur, making the asymptotic continuous KS p-value conservative. Complementary discrete-appropriate proportion tests are computed below to ensure valid statistical inference.

audit_finding_e_psi_sensitivity.stability_conclusion: Empirical stability certified: All top drifting legitimate features (SpacialCharRatioInURL, NoOfOtherSpecialCharsInURL, NoOfSubDomain, NoOfEqualsInURL, NoOfQMarkInURL, URLLength, DomainLength) consistently maintain SEVERE_SHIFT (PSI >= 0.25) across all bin counts (5, 10, 20) and all smoothing levels (0.000769 to 0.01). Feature rankings are invariant to bin granularity.
